caseName: Pleasure Driveway & Park District of Peoria v. Kurek
caseNameFull: Pleasure Driveway and Park District of Peoria, Illinois v. Kurek

opinions.text: C. A. 7th Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of City of Lafayette v. Louisiana Power & Light Co., ante, p. 389. Mr. Justice Stevens took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
